While the proteomics part is described as 'conventional' and 'label-free', the specific focus on glycopeptides and the use of PeaksPTM for glycosylation sites justifies the mod_glyco modifier.

scope: This protocol is an efficient and economical way of processing tissue or cell lysates to isolate various GAG classes and peptides from the same sample.

Our protocol follows a filter-aided sample preparation (FASP) type serial in-solution digestion of glycosaminoglycan (GAG) classes, including hyaluronan (HA), chondroitin sulfate (CS), and heparan sulfate (HS) followed by peptides from tissue or cell lysates (Fig 2).
We used commercially available mouse brain lysate as a complex sample to test our protocol, but this protocol applies to any tissue.
